environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL RDS. Database uses application-level tenant context setting (SET app.current_tenant) but RLS policies are NOT enabled on the tables. The pg role 'app_user' is a superuser for legacy migration reasons. Cache layer shares entries across tenants using resource-only keys.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, tables: orders, invoices, documents
config.network: ECS service in private subnet, ALB public-facing
config.tenant_isolation: application-level SET command only, no RLS FORCE
